headline: Nigerian States Fail to Translate Record FAAC Inflows Into Public Welfare
summary: Thirty-four Nigerian states spent only N8.60 trillion out of N35.22 trillion in Federation Account Allocation Committee inflows during the first half of 2026.
why: Subnational spending patterns and fiscal execution rates affect local infrastructure development and economic activity in emerging federations.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Low budget execution rates relative to revenue inflows reflect subdued public capital deployment.
